from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper and the other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    provided_paper_references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperReference]
